craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Distraction-proof desire (fixed-even-in-distraction); effort-people kept; pi-elision per UNC. Rejected: (a) even→still → killed: even holds the paradox. Read aloud: HIS, NA-ture-FIXED … IS at-TAINED.

lines: His, nature-fixed — in distraction even — that is desired;
this, by effort's power, by people is attained.

reads_against.argmap: What is desired even in distraction? → Desired in distraction; effort-attained by people.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of practiced freedom; raudra of devouring fire; vīra of soon attainment; adbhuta of shining universe; līlā-śānta of still play; karuṇa-vīra of freeing; śānta of standing; vīra of desired-in-distraction; adbhuta of shown vision; adbhuta of bodiless expansion
